sections.description:
🚀 Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode by XpertCodes

Transform your WordPress site with professional coming soon pages and maintenance mode screens! Coming Soon Pro is the ultimate solution for launching new websites, performing maintenance, or creating stunning landing pages that captivate your audience from the first visit.

🌟 Why Use Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode by XpertCodes?

A well-designed coming soon page is crucial for:
– Build Anticipation: Create buzz and collect emails before your launch
– Professional Appearance: Impress visitors with stunning, branded designs
– Reduce Bounce Rates: Engage visitors with beautiful layouts instead of error pages
– Mobile-First Design: Perfect experience on all devices and screen sizes
– SEO Friendly: Properly handle HTTP status codes for maintenance mode

🎨 Key Features

🎯 Smart Template System

  • Multiple Professional Templates – Choose from beautifully designed templates
  • Template-Specific Options – Each template has tailored customization options
  • Live Preview – See changes in real-time as you customize

🎨 Complete Customization

  • Branding Control – Upload your logo, set colors, and customize backgrounds
  • Background Options – Choose between image backgrounds or solid colors
  • Typography Control – Customize fonts, colors, and text content
  • Countdown Timer – Build excitement with customizable launch countdown

📱 Advanced Layout Features

  • Navigation Menu – Add custom menu items with individual colors and URLs
  • Social Media Integration – Connect social profiles with custom icons
  • Responsive Design – Flawless display on all devices and screen sizes
  • Mobile Menu Toggle – Optimized mobile navigation with customizable toggle

⚡ Smart Functionality

  • One-Click Enable/Disable – Turn coming soon mode on/off instantly
  • Admin Access Protected – Logged-in administrators see the normal site
  • Template Switching – Change designs without losing your settings
  • Required Field Validation – Ensures your pages look perfect before going live

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Coming Soon Pro”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the .zip file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Coming Soon Pro in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Toggle the “Enable Coming Soon Mode” switch to activate
  3. Choose your preferred template from the available options
  4. Customize all settings in the template options sections
  5. Click Save Changes to make your page live
sections.faq:
Can I use different templates for different pages?

Currently, the plugin uses one template site-wide. Future updates may include page-specific template selection.

Will search engines see my coming soon page?

Yes, when maintenance mode is active, proper HTTP headers are sent to inform search engines.

Can logged-in users see the normal site?

Yes, administrators and logged-in users (based on your settings) will see the normal website while visitors see the coming soon page.

What happens to my existing website content?

Your existing content remains completely safe and unchanged. The coming soon page only displays to visitors while your admin area functions normally.

Can I add my own custom CSS?

Yes, you can add custom CSS through the additional CSS field in the template settings or via your theme’s customizer.

Is the countdown timer timezone-aware?

Yes, the countdown timer automatically uses your WordPress site’s timezone settings.

Can I use my own background images?

Absolutely! You can upload custom background images or use the provided default images.
